# Mercy Speaks Digital

> Mercy Speaks Digital is a U.S. digital agency based in Richmond, TX (Houston metro), serving businesses nationwide. We build conversion-focused websites and e-commerce storefronts, install 24/7 AI phone receptionists, and set up automation (missed-call text-back, review generation, CRM follow-up) so small businesses stop missing leads.

Key facts: AI receptionist plans from $197/mo (Starter, ~500 calls), $397/mo (Growth, ~1,200 calls), $697/mo (Pro, ~3,000+ calls), each with one-time setup fees ($997/$2,500/$4,500). Websites from $997 (Starter), $1,997 (Business), custom for Premium. Typical AI receptionist go-live: 48–72 hours after onboarding. Contact: don@mercyspeaksdigital.com · (703) 332-5956.

## Services

- [AI Phone Receptionist](https://www.mercyspeaksdigital.com/services/ai-phone-receptionist): 24/7 call answering, lead qualification, appointment booking
- [Website Design & Development](https://www.mercyspeaksdigital.com/services/website-design): premium business websites and redesigns
- [Voice Agents](https://www.mercyspeaksdigital.com/services/voice-agents): custom call flows, routing, reminders
- [Website Chatbot](https://www.mercyspeaksdigital.com/services/website-chatbot): on-site chat that books appointments
- [Workflow Automation](https://www.mercyspeaksdigital.com/services/workflow-automation): CRM, lead routing, follow-up
- [Review Generation](https://www.mercyspeaksdigital.com/services/review-generation): automated review requests and monitoring
- [Social Media Management](https://www.mercyspeaksdigital.com/services/social-media-management)
